description: Search the directory of allergists offering ILIT. Give a zip code, a city, "City, ST", a state name or code, or coordinates. Results come nearest first with the distance in miles; a 50-mile radius splits "within" from "further", but people travel far for ILIT, so always show the closest ones even when none is within the radius. Optional filters: allergen, accepting new patients, treats children, video first consult.

accepting_new_patients.description: Only listings currently accepting new patients.

allergen.description: An allergen name or slug (grass pollen, tree pollen, ragweed, dust mite, cat, dog, mold, …).

latitude.description: With longitude: search around coordinates instead of a query.

query.description: Zip code, city, "City, ST", or a US state (name or two-letter code). Leave empty to list everything.

video_first_consult.description: Only listings offering a video first consult.

name: find_practitioners
title: Find ILIT practitioners
